primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: He had brothers, the sons of Jehoshaphat: Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, and Shephatiah. All these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 21:2に同名のアザルヤが二度並び、個人を区別する手掛かりがありません。
